title: Separate a complex slice insertion from a physical Gibbs pair bound
statement: The finite-slice offdiagonal insertion is an average of complex non-Hermitian matrices. Uniform r<1 number-insertion tails and fixed-sector convergence transfer its norm bound to the exact Gibbs pair operator. A divergent pair eigenvalue closes the fixed-beta-U curvature gate; a large hopping bandwidth alone cannot supply the missing ordered sector.
